author: Kushal
problem: Read N, X and N integers A. Print Yes if there are indices i and j (possibly equal) with A_i - A_j = X, otherwise No.
bug_description: Looks up X - a instead of a + X, which tests for two values summing to X rather than differing by X.

comments.accurate: Checks with a set whether some A_i minus some A_j equals X
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks with a set whether two of the values add up to X
comments.wrong_location: Set lookup verified; check that the early break leaves ok set correctly
